name: Factory installed restart listener readiness and recovery
command: --test-name-pattern=^(?:restart replaces a changed installed source using saved evidence and verifies the new PID and hash|restart runs the current working tree without requiring clean or saved verification|restart waits for a held integration lock and times out without stopping work or deleting it|restart discovers matching saved evidence and never reports ready if the replacement exits|an unknown deployment lock is preserved without pausing or stopping the server)$
